prks.identity_key(text).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prks.identity_key(s text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
BEGIN ATOMIC
 SELECT casefold((btrim(regexp_replace(NORMALIZE(s, NFC), '[\x09-\x0D\x1C-\x20\x85\xA0\x1680\x2000-\x200A\x2028\x2029\x202F\x205F\x3000]+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ' '::text) COLLATE pg_unicode_fast)) AS casefold;
END

prks.search_norm(text).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prks.search_norm(s text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
BEGIN ATOMIC
 SELECT ext.unaccent('prks.search_unaccent'::regdictionary, casefold((NORMALIZE(s, NFC) COLLATE pg_unicode_fast))) AS unaccent;
END

constraints.assets_kind_storage_check:
CHECK (
CASE kind
    WHEN 'managed_file'::text THEN storage_locator IS NOT NULL AND content_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND origin IS NOT NULL
    ELSE storage_locator IS NULL AND source_locator IS NULL AND origin IS NULL AND byte_size IS NULL AND ingest_sha256 IS NULL AND content_sha256 IS NULL AND origin_url IS NULL AND origin_ref IS NULL
END)

constraints.duplicate_decisions_ids_check:
CHECK (
CASE entity_type
    WHEN 'work'::text THEN low_id ~ '^W-[0-9A-F]{32}$'::text AND high_id ~ '^W-[0-9A-F]{32}$'::text
    WHEN 'manifestation'::text THEN low_id ~ '^MF-[0-9A-F]{32}$'::text AND high_id ~ '^MF-[0-9A-F]{32}$'::text
    ELSE low_id ~ '^AS-[0-9A-F]{32}$'::text AND high_id ~ '^AS-[0-9A-F]{32}$'::text
END)
